what: speed-conditioned healthy thresholds, AE-6 and B1s separately (exploratory, development data, Stage 3C seed-42 LOCO runs)
in_sample_bias: In-sample bias: m(speed) and d(speed) are fitted on the healthy fit normals, which AE-6 was trained on and B1s was fitted on, so their scores are in-sample and optimistically low; this biases the standardised score upward for calibration and evaluation recordings, against the new method. A positive result is therefore conservative and meaningful; a negative result is partly attributable to this bias and does not by itself refute speed-conditioning; the clean alternative (out-of-fold scores on the fit normals) does not exist in this project.
caveat: 25 healthy recordings from one folder (one recording = 4 percentage points); speed and recording identity are completely confounded; only 5 recordings lie outside the bundle calibration-normal speed range; R0's hypothesis remains a hypothesis.

reproduction.what: reproduction of the saved Stage 3C (AE-6) and Stage 3D (B1s) cal/eval scores before the fit-normal scores are used
